_comment: Maps English glosses from the source document to MP3 filenames when they do not match automatically. Keys are the gloss exactly as it appears in grammar-alphabet.tsv.
_uncertain_comment: Alias is a best guess and needs a speaker to confirm. These entries are flagged needs_review.
_noAudio_comment: Present in the document but no matching recording exists in the archive.
_unusedAudio_comment: Recordings with no matching word in the source document. Need the Klallam text from a speaker before they can be used.
